free_tier.stated: Free: 5 recorded videos per month, 25 videos in the library at once, 30 minutes max length. AI video generation capped separately.

egress.terms: Free sharing links; hosting of video is effectively a paid feature.

tooling: No yt-dlp extractor (absent from `--list-extractors`). No public upload API on Free.
chaining: 5/month x unlimited accounts — but 25-slot library means each account tops out at 25 videos.
limits_note: 5 new videos/month and a 25-video rolling library. Deleting is mandatory to keep uploading; it cannot accumulate.
reliability_note: The 25-video library cap plus monthly creation limit means capacity never grows. Retrieval has no supported automation path.

evidence.proved: 'You can have up to 25 videos in your Library at once ... delete old ones to make space'
